test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 9 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.

__Spurious__ medicine can be fatal to the patient.
solution:
The correct answer is **GENUINE.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__****

__
 
• **Genuine **means if it is a genuine Michelangelo drawing, it will sell for millions.

 
 
• *Eg. *there was* genuine* affection in his voice
 
 
 
• **Spurious **means false and not what it appears to be, or (of reasons and judgments).
 
 
• ***Eg.*** Some of the arguments in favour of shutting the factory are questionable and others downright *spurious.*
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__** 

Here let's explain the meaning of the other antonym's with examples:

 
• **INFERIOR **means not good, or not as good as someone or something else

** *​ Eg*.** These products are *inferior* to those we bought last year

 
• **CONTEMPTUOUS **means expressing contempt.

 
 
• ***Eg***. He was very *contemptuous* of "popular" writers, whom he described as having no talent.
 
 
 
• **VIRTUOUS **means having good moral qualities and behaviour.
 
 
• ***Eg.*** He described them as* virtuous* and hard-working people.
